quest.title: Rishboland Tiger, Roaaar
quest.description: Seems that Arakanta wants to play Rishboland Tiger and Aranara.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x20000

talks.objective: Act as the Rishboland Tiger and catch all the Aranara

dialogues.speaker: Arakanta
dialogues.text: Good? Nara willing to play game with Arakanta now?

dialogues.speaker: Arakanta
dialogues.text: Nara didn't win... But it's okay, Arakanta will play with Nara again!

dialogues.speaker: Arakanta
dialogues.text: So much fun! Arakanta is very happy playing games with Golden Nara! And Nara is so fast! So amazing! Like a real tiger!

dialogues.speaker: Arakanta
dialogues.text: It is fun playing with other Aranara and real Rishboland Tigers, but playing with our new friend, our Nara friend, is even more fun!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why would the Rishboland Tiger chase Aranara?

dialogues.speaker: Arakanta
dialogues.text: The Rishboland Tiger and Aranara are friends, and friends play together. But Arakanta noticed that Nara are afraid of the Rishboland Tiger. That's why Arakanta came up with a new game for Festival Utsava!

dialogues.speaker: Arakanta
dialogues.text: Thank you, Nara. Here is an Aranara flower for Golden Nara!

dialogues.speaker: Arakanta
dialogues.text: Golden Nara, Arakanta has heard so much about you. You are a good Nara. Will you play with Arakanta?

dialogues.speaker: Arakanta
dialogues.text: Arakanta's game is simple and fun! Listen to the rules, Nara...

dialogues.speaker: Arakanta
dialogues.text: Arakanta will summon a lot of Dendro particles, which are "Aranara" hiding in the circle. Nara is a big and powerful "Rishboland Tiger." Come and chase "Aranara"!

dialogues.speaker: Arakanta
dialogues.text: If the "Rishboland Tiger" catches all the Aranara in a short time, then Nara wins!

dialogues.speaker: Arakanta
dialogues.text: Good? Nara willing to play game with Arakanta now?
